name: pnullseg
oracle: Intel 243191-001 MOV pp.3-287/3-289 (PDF316-319); QEMU softmmu is not a null-data-access oracle
description: Strict #GP(0) for null DS0/ES3 reads and writes. Each handler checks original fault EIP, error0, saved CS, all8 GPRs, original ESP, status/control flags, null selectors and untouched target+neighbors; return checks live GPRs/flags. Legal SS override/default-SS read+write controls with nullDS and ordinary DS read+write with nullES. Does not replace pselnull's LDT/task/paging/hidden-cache obligations.
